facts: Hicks Consulting PLLC is the practice of Monika Hicks, LCSW, a licensed clinical social worker with an independent practice in Tennessee.
Therapy at Hicks Consulting is virtual only, by secure video, for adults who are located in Tennessee during sessions.
Most of Monika's therapy clients are high-achieving Black women; clients of every background are welcome.
In therapy, Monika works with anxiety and overthinking, burnout, depression and low mood, low self-esteem and perfectionism, relationship strain and boundaries, grief and life transitions.
Monika uses Solution Focused Therapy; a client's Christian faith is part of sessions only when the client wants it.
Therapy sessions last 53 to 60 minutes; the first appointment is an intake and assessment, and most clients then meet weekly.
Therapy fees: initial intake and assessment $200, a 60-minute virtual session $165, a 30-minute virtual session $85.
Hicks Consulting is private pay: a superbill can be provided for possible out-of-network reimbursement, and HSA/FSA and credit cards are accepted.
Cancelling or rescheduling needs 24 hours' notice; a late cancellation or missed session is $75.
When medication may help, Monika can refer a client to a prescriber for medication management.
Life coaching with Monika is structured, non-clinical and virtual, open to women in Tennessee and beyond, for decisions, boundaries, confidence and transitions.
Coaching fees: $185 per 60-minute session, a 4-session package $700 and an 8-session package $1,360, with a free coaching consultation.
Monika leads virtual support groups for women; some are therapist-led and therapeutic, others educational, and people ask about openings through the form on the groups page.

Monika leads keynotes, workshops, leadership sessions and series for organizations, in person or virtual, on burnout, compassion fatigue, boundaries, trauma-informed leadership and workplace mental health.
Monika holds an MSSW from the University of Tennessee Knoxville and a BS in Clinical Psychology from Middle Tennessee State University, and has over a decade as a mental health provider.
Therapy and coaching consultations are booked through SimplePractice, the practice's secure client portal; organizational training starts with a proposal request.
Office hours: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Friday 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and Sunday by appointment only with limited availability.
lacks: Hicks Consulting does not provide crisis or emergency services; in a crisis, call or text 988, and if there is immediate danger call 911.
Hicks Consulting does not offer in-person therapy or coaching sessions or office visits; only organizational trainings can be in person.
Hicks Consulting does not take insurance or bill an insurer; it is private pay.
Hicks Consulting does not offer therapy to anyone outside Tennessee during the session.
Coaching is not therapy and does not replace mental health treatment.
Hicks Consulting does not promise or guarantee any result from therapy, coaching, a group or a training.
